en.name: Wax beans
en.summary: Wax beans are simply yellow snap beans — the same vegetable as a green bean, without the chlorophyll. Refrigerated they keep about 3–5 days from the day you buy them, and blanched and frozen they hold good quality for about 8 months.
en.pantry: Fresh pods are not a pantry item. At room temperature they lose water quickly, go limp and rubbery, and develop rusty brown spots along the pod. There is no counter-storage timeline for them; refrigerate them the day you buy them and leave them unwashed until you cook.
en.fridge: Store wax beans unwashed in a perforated or loosely closed bag in the crisper at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, and use them within about 3–5 days of purchase. Moisture is the enemy on two fronts — they dry out if left bare, and they slime if sealed wet — so a bag with some airflow and a sheet of kitchen paper inside handles both. Do not trim the ends until you are ready to cook.
en.freezer: Freezing works well, but only after blanching: the enzymes that turn frozen beans tough and hay-flavoured are not switched off by cold alone. Blanch trimmed pods briefly, chill them in iced water, dry them, and freeze them spread on a tray before bagging so they stay loose. At −18 °C (0 °F) expect about 8 months of good quality; they stay safe beyond that, but the texture and flavour drift.
en.thawing: Do not thaw wax beans. Tip them straight from the freezer into boiling water, a steamer or a hot pan — thawed first, they turn soft and watery.
spoilage: Pods that bend limply instead of snapping cleanly
Brown or rust-coloured spots spreading along the pod
A slimy film, especially where beans were bagged wet
Mould at the stem ends, or a sour smell in the bag
tips: Choose slim, firm pods that snap when bent; big bulging ones are over-mature and stringy.
Do not wash before storing; wash at the sink just before cooking.
Put a sheet of kitchen paper in the bag to mop up condensation.
Freeze in meal-sized portions and label them with the date.

faq.q: How long do wax beans last in the fridge?
faq.a: About 3–5 days from the day of purchase, unwashed in a loosely closed bag at 4 °C or below.
Yes — blanch them first, then freeze at −18 °C for about 8 months of good quality. Freezing raw makes them tough and hay-flavoured.

faq.q: Are wax beans the same as green beans?
faq.a: Essentially yes. They are the same vegetable in a yellow variety, and they are stored and cooked identically.

faq.q: Should you wash wax beans before storing them?
faq.a: No. Surface water makes them slimy in the bag. Store dry and unwashed, and rinse just before cooking.

zh.name: 黃四季豆
zh.summary: 黃四季豆其實就是黃色的四季豆，和綠色的是同一種蔬菜，只是少了葉綠素。冷藏從購買日起算大約可放 3～5 天；先汆燙再冷凍的話，風味可以維持大約 8 個月。
zh.pantry: 新鮮豆莢不是常溫食材。室溫下失水很快，會變軟、變得像橡皮，豆莢上還會冒出鏽褐色斑點。它沒有常溫保存的天數；買回來當天就冷藏，下鍋前都不要洗。
zh.fridge: 不要洗，裝進有孔或鬆口的袋子放進 4 °C 以下的蔬果室，並在購買後大約 3～5 天內用完。水分在兩個方向上都會害到它——完全裸放會乾癟，帶著水密封則會變黏——所以「留一點透氣的袋子＋一張廚房紙巾」剛好兩邊都顧到。要煮之前才切掉蒂頭。
zh.freezer: 冷凍效果很好，但一定要先汆燙：讓冷凍豆莢變老、產生乾草味的酵素，光靠低溫是關不掉的。把切好的豆莢快速汆燙、冰水冰鎮、擦乾，攤平在盤子上先凍硬再裝袋，這樣才不會結成一塊。在 −18 °C 下風味大約可維持 8 個月；之後仍然安全，只是口感和味道會走樣。
zh.thawing: 黃四季豆不要解凍。直接從冷凍下滾水、蒸鍋或熱鍋——先解凍會變得軟爛出水。
spoilage: 豆莢彎折時軟軟地彎過去，而不是清脆折斷
豆莢上出現褐色或鏽色斑點並且擴散
表面出現黏膜，特別是帶著水裝袋的部分
蒂頭處長霉，或袋子裡有酸味
tips: 挑細長、結實、折起來會斷的；鼓脹的大莢代表過熟、纖維多。
存放前不要洗，下鍋前再沖洗。
袋子裡放一張廚房紙巾吸冷凝水。
按一餐的份量分裝冷凍，並寫上日期。

faq.q: 黃四季豆放冰箱可以放多久？
faq.a: 從購買日起算大約 3～5 天，不洗、鬆口裝袋放在 4 °C 以下。
可以，但要先汆燙，再放 −18 °C 冷凍，風味大約可維持 8 個月。生凍會變老並出現乾草味。

faq.q: 黃四季豆和一般四季豆一樣嗎？
faq.a: 基本上一樣。只是黃色的品種，保存方式和烹調方式都相同。

faq.q: 黃四季豆要先洗再冰嗎？
faq.a: 不要。表面帶水在袋子裡會變黏。請乾燥不洗存放，下鍋前再沖。
